title: Houthis Claim Drone Strikes on Najran Airport and Aramco Facility
detail: Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group struck a 'sensitive target' at Najran Regional Airport and an Aramco facility in Najran province with drones, calling both hits precise. Saudi Arabia issued no confirmation of damage or casualties. The claimed strikes came as UN Yemen envoy Hans Grundberg warned the country faces its highest risk of returning to full-scale war since the 2022 truce, and Iran's IRGC warned Saudi Arabia would be 'unable to contain' the Houthis as attacks intensified.

media.caption: Houthi attacks and Yemen's slide back toward full-scale war

confidenceReason: Attack claimed by Houthi spokesperson; Saudi Arabia provided no independent confirmation of impact.
